faq.q: What boats are available for a sunset photoshoot in Marbella?
faq.a: We offer the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax). Both depart from Puerto Banús and are ideal for a 2-hour sunset session.

faq.q: How much does a sunset photoshoot yacht session cost?
faq.a: The rate is €749 for a 2-hour charter, which includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and Spanish VAT (21%). No extra costs.

faq.q: Can I bring my own photographer?
faq.a: Yes, absolutely. You are welcome to bring your own photographer or arrange one independently. We do not provide a photographer as part of the charter.

faq.q: What time does the sunset photoshoot session start?
faq.a: Departure times depend on the season. In summer (June–September), sunset is around 21:00–21:30, so we typically depart at 18:00 or 19:00. We will confirm the exact time upon booking.

faq.q: What is included in the charter besides the boat?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Just bring your camera and swimwear.

faq.q: Can I extend the session to 3 or 4 hours?
faq.a: The sunset photoshoot is designed as a 2-hour experience. For longer charters, please contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote. Other boats with longer durations are available.

faq.q: What is the maximum number of guests?
faq.a: The Astondoa 40 accommodates up to 9 guests, and the Azimut 39 up to 11 guests. These numbers include everyone on board, not just those being photographed.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad?
faq.a: We monitor weather conditions closely. If the captain deems it unsafe to sail, we will reschedule your session at no extra cost or issue a full refund.

data.body_html:
Capture the golden hour over the Mediterranean with a private sunset photoshoot yacht session in Marbella. Departing from Puerto Banús, this 2-hour charter is perfect for couples, influencers, or anyone wanting stunning photos against the Costa del Sol sunset. Choose from the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – both at a flat rate of €749, including skipper, drinks, snacks, and all taxes. No hidden fees, no surprises.

Why a Sunset Photoshoot on a Yacht?

Marbella’s sunset is legendary – the sky turns shades of orange, pink, and purple over the Mediterranean. A private yacht gives you an unobstructed view, away from crowded beaches. You control the backdrop: the silhouette of La Concha mountain, the luxury yachts of Puerto Banús, or the open sea. With a licensed skipper handling the boat, you focus entirely on the shoot.

Choose Your Yacht

Both options are modern, well-maintained motor yachts departing from Puerto Banús. They offer spacious decks, comfortable seating, and plenty of natural light for photography.

Both charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and Spanish IVA (21%). No extra costs.

What to Expect on the Day

You’ll meet your skipper at Puerto Banús, just a short walk from the main marina. After a safety briefing, you’ll cruise along the coast towards Cabopino or Estepona, depending on wind conditions. The skipper will position the boat for the best light. You have full freedom to move around the yacht – bow, stern, flybridge, or cockpit. Bring your own photographer or hire one locally. We recommend arriving 15 minutes early to set up.

Best Time for Sunset Photos

In summer (June to September), sunset occurs between 21:00 and 21:30. We typically depart at 18:00 or 19:00 to allow time to reach a scenic spot and shoot during the golden hour. In spring and autumn, sunset is earlier (18:00–20:00), so departure times adjust accordingly. We confirm exact times upon booking.

What’s Included

  • Licensed skipper (English & Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the entire charter
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (olives, nuts, crisps)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – no hidden taxes

How to Book

Booking is simple. Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date and number of guests. We’ll confirm availability and send you a payment link. A 50% deposit secures the booking; the balance is due on the day. For more information on all our charters, visit our Marbella boat rental page.

Frequently asked questions

What boats are available for a sunset photoshoot in Marbella?

We offer the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax). Both depart from Puerto Banús and are ideal for a 2-hour sunset session.

How much does a sunset photoshoot yacht session cost?

The rate is €749 for a 2-hour charter, which includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and Spanish VAT (21%). No extra costs.

Can I bring my own photographer?

Yes, absolutely. You are welcome to bring your own photographer or arrange one independently. We do not provide a photographer as part of the charter.

What time does the sunset photoshoot session start?

Departure times depend on the season. In summer (June–September), sunset is around 21:00–21:30, so we typically depart at 18:00 or 19:00. We will confirm the exact time upon booking.

What is included in the charter besides the boat?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Just bring your camera and swimwear.

Can I extend the session to 3 or 4 hours?

The sunset photoshoot is designed as a 2-hour experience. For longer charters, please contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote. Other boats with longer durations are available.

The Astondoa 40 accommodates up to 9 guests, and the Azimut 39 up to 11 guests. These numbers include everyone on board, not just those being photographed.

What happens if the weather is bad?
